title: Canonical tower differential on filtered representatives
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], and let U=(K,F) be a finite filtered integer-indexed cochain complex [def-sp-filtration]. For every such V and integers p,q,r with r>=1, suppose hBZ gives B_r^(p,q)(V)<=Z_r^(p,q)(V), with the graded cycle and boundary subobjects of [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Suppose eH identifies coker(B_1->Z_1) with H^(p+q)(gr^p V). Assume eH is normalized as follows: there are maps z from the first cycle representatives to Z_1 and g from those representatives to the graded cycles, both inducing the graded quotient of the representative inclusion, with z epic and z pi eH=g pi_H. Let X be the concrete homology exact couple of (K,F) [def-sp-filtered-homology-exact-couple], with its canonical cycle-boundary tower T [def-sp-convergence] and initial equality isomorphism e0:X.E(2p+q,-p)->H^(p+q)(gr^p K). Write j_s^(p,q):Z_(s+1)^(p,q)->cycles(gr^p K,p+q) and t_s^(p,q):Z_(s+1)^(p,q)->T.Z(s,2p+q,-p). Their normalization equations are j_s iCycles=the graded cycle-subobject inclusion and t_s T.Z.arrow e0=j_s pi_H. For any families j,t satisfying these equations, any natural s and integers p,q, set r=s+1 and (pprime,qprime)=(p+r,q-r+1). Let A be any object and let a:A->(F^p K)^(p+q), aprime:A->(F^pprime K)^(pprime+qprime), x:A->Z_r^(p,q), y:A->Z_r^(pprime,qprime). Suppose the ambient differential of a is the ambient inclusion of aprime, and the graded projections of a and aprime are respectively the subobject inclusions of x and y. Then x t_s^(p,q) T.projection(s,2p+q,-p) X.pageCouple(s).d(2p+q,-p), followed by the integer-index equality transport to (2pprime+qprime,-pprime), equals y t_s^(pprime,qprime) T.projection(s,2pprime+qprime,-pprime). This equation needs neither epic x nor quotient comparison isomorphisms.

proof.text: The differential of aprime vanishes after the monic filtration inclusion since d squared is zero. Construct its unique lift b to the cycles of F^(p+s+1).

Choose the canonical derived-D inclusions I from pageCouple_image_prefix and the concrete comparisonLift of alphaIter (the recursive image lift used in the finite-cycle comparison). Its inclusion equation is comparisonLift_inclusion.
Apply the proved forward-representative identity to a and b to calculate page f of the projected class x.

The finite-cycle pullback formula and initial g followed by f equals zero show that initial g factors through the canonical tower cycle subobject. Apply finiteCycle_derived_comparison to identify the lifted class followed by page g with that factorization followed by the tower projection.

Unfold filteredHomologyG and the initial homology isomorphism. Naturality of homology projection for the graded quotient, monicity of graded cycle inclusions, hy, hj and ht identify the class of b under the initial-g factorization with y followed by tQ. Compose the forward identity with page g; d=f followed by g, and equality transports normalize the bidegrees.

theorem filteredHomology_tower_differential
    (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (hBZ : ∀ (U : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
          (fun W : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ↦ W.filtration.IsFinite))
      (p q r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r),
      U.obj.filtration.complexBoundaries p (p + q) r ≤
        U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) r)
    (eH : ∀ (U : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
          (fun W : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ↦ W.filtration.IsFinite)) (p q : ℤ),
      cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (hBZ U p q 1 (by omega))) ≅
        (U.obj.filtration.gradedPiece p).homology (p + q))
    (hH : ∀ (U : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
          (fun W : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ↦ W.filtration.IsFinite)) (p q : ℤ),
      ∃ (z : (U.obj.filtration.complexCycleRepresentatives p (p + q) 1 : C) ⟶
          (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) 1 : C))
        (g : (U.obj.filtration.complexCycleRepresentatives p (p + q) 1 : C) ⟶
          (U.obj.filtration.gradedPiece p).cycles (p + q)),
        z ≫ (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) 1).arrow =
          (U.obj.filtration.complexCycleRepresentatives p (p + q) 1).arrow ≫
            (U.obj.filtration.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)).f (p + q) ∧
        g ≫ (U.obj.filtration.gradedPiece p).iCycles (p + q) =
          (U.obj.filtration.complexCycleRepresentatives p (p + q) 1).arrow ≫
            (U.obj.filtration.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)).f (p + q) ∧
        Epi z ∧
        z ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (hBZ U p q 1 (by omega))) ≫
            (eH U p q).hom =
          g ≫ (U.obj.filtration.gradedPiece p).homologyπ (p + q))
    (U : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
          (fun W : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ↦ W.filtration.IsFinite))
    (j : ∀ (s : ℕ) (p q : ℤ),
      (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) (s + 1) : C) ⟶
        (U.obj.filtration.gradedPiece p).cycles (p + q))
    (tQ : ∀ (s : ℕ) (p q : ℤ),
      (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) (s + 1) : C) ⟶
        ((filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).cycleBoundaryTower.Z
          s (2 * p + q) (-p) : C))
    (hj : ∀ (s : ℕ) (p q : ℤ),
      j s p q ≫ (U.obj.filtration.gradedPiece p).iCycles (p + q) =
        (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) (s + 1)).arrow)
    (ht : ∀ (s : ℕ) (p q : ℤ),
      tQ s p q ≫
          ((filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).cycleBoundaryTower.Z
            s (2 * p + q) (-p)).arrow ≫
          (filteredHomologyEIso U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration p q).hom =
        j s p q ≫ (U.obj.filtration.gradedPiece p).homologyπ (p + q))
    (s : ℕ) (p q : ℤ)
    (A : C)
    (a : A ⟶ (U.obj.filtration.step p : CochainComplex C ℤ).X (p + q))
    (a' : A ⟶ (U.obj.filtration.step (p + (s + 1)) :
      CochainComplex C ℤ).X (p + (s + 1) + (q - (s + 1) + 1)))
    (x : A ⟶ (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) (s + 1) : C))
    (y : A ⟶ (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles (p + (s + 1))
      (p + (s + 1) + (q - (s + 1) + 1)) (s + 1) : C))
    (ha : a ≫ (U.obj.filtration.step p).arrow.f (p + q) ≫
      U.obj.obj.d (p + q) (p + (s + 1) + (q - (s + 1) + 1)) =
      a' ≫ (U.obj.filtration.step (p + (s + 1))).arrow.f
        (p + (s + 1) + (q - (s + 1) + 1)))
    (hx : x ≫ (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) (s + 1)).arrow =
      a ≫ (U.obj.filtration.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)).f (p + q))
    (hy : y ≫ (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles (p + (s + 1))
      (p + (s + 1) + (q - (s + 1) + 1)) (s + 1)).arrow =
      a' ≫ (U.obj.filtration.complexQuotientπ (p + (s + 1))
        (p + (s + 1) + 1) (by omega)).f
          (p + (s + 1) + (q - (s + 1) + 1))) :
    x ≫ tQ s p q ≫
        (filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).cycleBoundaryTower.projection
          s (2 * p + q) (-p) ≫
        ((filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).pageCouple s).d
          (2 * p + q) (-p) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg₂
          ((filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).pageCouple s).E
          (show 2 * p + q + 2 + s =
            2 * (p + (s + 1)) + (q - (s + 1) + 1) by omega)
          (show -p - 1 - s = -(p + (s + 1)) by omega)) =
      y ≫ tQ s (p + (s + 1)) (q - (s + 1) + 1) ≫
        (filteredHomologyExactCouple U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration).cycleBoundaryTower.projection
          s (2 * (p + (s + 1)) + (q - (s + 1) + 1)) (-(p + (s + 1)))
